description:
Programme Overview

The Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG) in Barcelona is a leading international biomedical research institute offering fully funded 4-year PhD fellowships through its International PhD Programme. The programme provides an exceptionally vibrant scientific environment with internationally leading laboratories, core technologies, and a comprehensive training portfolio.

Research Areas

Research at the CRG embraces a wide spectrum of disciplines including computational biology and health genomics, genome biology, quantitative cell biology, systems and synthetic biology, and single-cell genomics. PhD students conduct their research within internationally leading laboratories.

Fellowships Available

  • Up to 5 fellowships funded by MICIU/AEI and FSE+.
  • Remaining positions funded by individual labs through various sources including ERC grants, CRG core funding, and project-based support.
  • Selected PhD students receive an annual work contract with a competitive salary for 4 years following applicable national regulations.
  • Full health and occupational insurance coverage included in Spanish Social Security System.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to candidates of any nationality.
  • Must have obtained a University Bachelor's Degree and a Master's Degree in biomedical sciences within the European Higher Education System (minimum 300 ECTS) or an equivalent University Degree that allows starting a PhD thesis in Spain.
  • Candidates expecting to be awarded such a degree by September 2027 are eligible to apply.
  • Must have an excellent academic record, previous research experience, and a strong commitment to scientific research.
  • Must have a high working knowledge of English.
  • Candidates invited to previous CRG PhD call interviews are not eligible.
  • Candidates performing their Masters at the CRG are not eligible.
  • Candidates may not have worked at the CRG for more than 3 months before the call deadline.

Application Process

  1. Applications must be submitted online through the CRG application system.
  2. Register to use the online application system.
  3. Complete the online form with general information, education, academic transcripts, scholarships/prizes/awards, research experience, scientific interests, and reference letters.
  4. If academic transcripts are not in Catalan, Spanish, or English, attach a translation.
  5. Two reference letters will be automatically requested from proposed referees.
  6. Select a maximum of 2 CRG labs where you would like to start a PhD.
  7. Incomplete proposals will not be considered.

Selection Process

  • Pre-selection based on application, reference letters, research interests, motivation, and fit to selected labs.
  • If pre-selected, invited to online panel interview on 13 January 2027.
  • If successful, invited to Barcelona for in-person interviews from 23-26 February 2027. Accommodation and flight tickets provided.
  • Offers made shortly after interview. Successful candidates expected to start PhD no later than October 2027.

Official Link

https://www.crg.eu/en/content/training-phd-students/crg-international-phd-fellowships-programme-2027

Important Notes

  • 4-year fully funded fellowships.
  • Competitive salary with full health and occupational insurance coverage.
  • Open to candidates of any nationality.
  • Two reference letters required.
  • Online workshops available: 1 October 2026, 21 October 2026, 12 November 2026.
